texts.preamble: Bherulal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through Food ... on 30 September, 2019 :1: Cr.R.No. 4768 / 2019 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh,Indore Bench Cr.R.No. 4768/ 2019 Bherulal vs. State of M.P. Indore, Dated:30/09/2019
texts.facts: Also heard on IA No.7944/2019, which is an application under Section 397 (1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of the petitioner.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been released on regular bail during trial and previously his custodial sentence was suspended by the lower Appellate Court and there is no possibility of the early hearing of this criminal revision before this Court.
